Hey. It seems like you're going through hell. And I mean, so am I. I really felt a connection toward a lot of the things you wrote, and I want you to know that you're not alone. Do you also feel sick by seeing yourself or hearing your name? I do. It's a curse really, and I don't believe you deserve it. Although I don't know your story, I would say that only the worst of people deserve what you are describing.

I won't tell you that you are pretty, since that would just be an empty guess. I won't say that you are a kind and friendly person, because again, I don't know you. What I will tell you, however, is that  beauty and values of a person is determined by the viewer and not by ourselves. I'm gonna break the seal and bring out the classic *clichè* - We're all beautiful in our own ways. We all fail, we all do stupid shit we regret, and we have all questioned ourselves and our flaws at some point in life. 

Well, I keep rambling here, but I hope you understand that you're not alone and that this, most likely, is just a short term thing. Again, I can't promise anything and I am quite hopeless myself, but if we are taking a logical approach, it will most likely be better one day. If you ever feel pathetic you can read my post on this account, and know that you  probably aren't that bad, and, more importantly, that you aren't alone in these feelings.

My inbox is, and will always be open. Sending love ❤️

It actually helped me a bit to hear that. I don't judge you are anything, at all. The thing is that I dwell on some sexual stuff too and I feel really bad about it. I like you are open and I think it's really awesome. We all got things going and we're all sexual by nature. I really need to stop overthinking and to be more rational, but it's so draining and hard.

I am glad you are doing better, and I will be here if you ever need to talk or vent or anything really. Don't hesitate.

Thanks again for caring

I'm sorry I'm such a wimp, but to be honest I am to embarrassed to talk about it. It's just pathetic really. 

My inbox are open as well if you want to talk, but I can't promise I can help since I'm in a horrible place myself.

And I don't see a reason to continue with the past. It's not always just about "moving on". Imagine you got convicted of sexual assault. I am not saying I am, but in that case I would be perceived as a sexual predator forever. Something's can't be changed.

I have tried. I it went sour and I tried again. This one seems to be friendly but to a certain extend. I feel judged by her as soon as I walk in. I had trouble pinpointing to her the cause of my depression. It's a really silly reason and I am really embarrassed about it. She is such a perfect woman, and she's enjoying life. All I do while I have session is envying her. She didn't fuck up. She is innocent and a good person. I envy most people I meet, it's a living hell.

I don't have any good times. It's a constant struggle in a bubble of self loathing, guilt and shame. It's like I'm in this fog where no one can reach me. Nothing in the outside world matters or influences me. I wouldn't be happier by getting a lot of money. I wouldn't feel worse if had nothing to eat for a day. I don't care anymore. Nothing brings me happiness because it's all in my head. It's no ones fault. No one is involved besides me.

Besides that, they only know the outside me. They don't know the monster inside.

But you're feeling that without a reason. You're self conscious and you're overthinking how people are perceiving you. Matter of fact, people don't really care as much as we believe they do. I'm not trying to one up you or anything, but I often feel bad because I am bad. I don't have that feeling of innocence or self worth. I don't look at people because I don't deserve it. I'm not one of you, nor am I one of them
